note: Bright Trill makes the greeting lively
Qaro is a proper name, written phonetically

english: I miss you all the time.

qaroshi: më pëla, ti sëna nu zëru ya, ko ti mi-wa sëna nëra-ki.
english: Please never die, so you can stay with me forever.

qaroshi: wen ti nëra do mi rënawë.
më pëla mi-m nu ngëmiro ya.
më pëla ti mi-tu shiri ya.

english: We see stars in the sky.
I travel from home toward the waterside shelter.
The rain travels toward the sea.
They flew, according to a report.

qaroshi: hë ti ruki qaro-m tika-te he?
sen sa haro do mi sëmi.
sen sa goro-yu do mi shërawë.
hë ti ti-na shëno-m hari he?
sen wë sa goro-yu, mi sa-m tika-yu.
english: If they fly, I will see them.

qaroshi: sen sa haro, uro sa ngëmarëho-m hari.
english: They are well, although they are exhausted.

qaroshi: sen sa shiri ara mi shëliro.
sen mi gura oru mi nëra.
english: Either I go or I stay.

qaroshi: sen sa nu goro, ro sa banu-ri-m nu hari.
english: They don't fly because they have no wings.

qaroshi: sen mi tika-te sha mara-m nashi.
english: I cherish the friend I saw.

qaroshi: sen sa haro do mi sëmi.
english: I know that they are safe.

qaroshi: sen mi mela zaki tëno sa.

english: Could you fly, from what you have personally observed?

qaroshi: më pëla ti mi-wa sëna nëra-ki.
english: Please be able to stay with me forever.
